changelog: Premium, 3D public website: animated hero with a floating fan of 3D product cards, a trust strip, 3D tilt category tiles, product cards with a shine effect, a 'Why choose us' section, a bold Track-order band, and smooth scroll reveals — the kind of site that wins orders.
Added a Login button to the public site header for quick staff sign-in from any phone.
Super Admin can now delete an order from its page (soft delete; the order and its payments leave every list but stay in the database for audit).
The login-page image is now set from Settings — upload a clear, high-resolution version any time.
